general.title: L2P Multi-Comparison Pathway Analysis
general.instructions: Attach or upload one wide DEG table and enter comparison IDs in the exact order to analyze and plot. Leave DEG Table blank to use the attached demo asset or one unambiguous workflow DEG table. The demo presets use Mouse and B-A,C-A,B-C; replace them for your data. Threshold selection (p-value <= 0.05 and absolute fold change >= 1.2) and adjusted-p-value bubble-plot significance are the defaults. Advanced sections expose every supported canonical tuning control; retired legacy-renderer and platform output-path controls are intentionally hidden.

datasets.name: Demo DEG Table
datasets.description: Mouse multi-comparison DEG table mounted at /data/deg_table. Replace it with one matching wide table or select a file explicitly.

categories.name: Main: Input and Comparisons
categories.description: Choose the DEG table and ordered comparisons.

categories.name: Advanced: Column Overrides
categories.description: Override automatic gene and comparison-column discovery only for nonstandard tables.

categories.name: Main: Gene Selection
categories.description: Select differential genes by thresholds or the optional legacy rank method.

categories.name: Main: Pathways
categories.description: Choose pathway collections and result-selection criteria.

categories.name: Advanced: Custom Pathways
categories.description: Add a compatible custom pathway table or RDS object.

categories.name: Main: Shared Bubble Plots
categories.description: Configure standardized OMIX pathway bubble plots.

parameters.name: DEG Table
parameters.description: Optional explicit CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS DEG table. Leave blank to use exactly one supported table from the attached /data/deg_table asset or one unambiguous workflow DEG result.

parameters.name: Custom Pathway File
parameters.description: Optional CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS custom pathway database. It may be used alone or with built-in collections.

parameters.name: Comparisons
parameters.description: Required comma-separated comparison IDs in the exact analysis and plot order. IDs infer matching columns when overrides are blank. The demo uses B-A,C-A,B-C.

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.description: Optional exact gene-symbol column. Leave blank to infer a common gene column name.

parameters.name: T-Statistic Columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated signed-rank columns aligned one-to-one with Comparisons. Leave blank to infer them.

parameters.name: Significance Columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated p-value or adjusted-p-value columns aligned one-to-one with Comparisons. Leave blank to infer them.

parameters.name: Fold Change Columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated linear- or log-fold-change columns aligned one-to-one with Comparisons. Leave blank to infer them.

parameters.name: Species
parameters.description: Species used for gene-symbol validation and ortholog mapping. Mouse is the attached demo preset; the canonical portable default is Human.

parameters.name: Update Gene Symbols
parameters.description: Update symbols for L2P while retaining original symbols in results.

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.description: Comma-separated built-in collection codes: GO, REACTOME, KEGG, PANTH, PID, BIOCYC, WikiPathways, H, C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, or C8. Leave blank only when providing custom pathways alone.

parameters.name: Select By Rank
parameters.description: FALSE selects genes by significance and fold-change thresholds. TRUE uses the legacy t-statistic rank method.

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage of Genes
parameters.description: With rank selection, use the top and bottom 10 percent rather than a fixed gene count.

parameters.name: Number of Top Genes
parameters.description: With rank selection and percentage selection disabled, select this many genes from each end of each ranking.

parameters.name: Gene Significance Threshold
parameters.description: Maximum nominal p-value, or threshold applied to explicitly selected adjusted-p-value columns, for DEG selection.

parameters.name: Fold Change Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum absolute linear fold change for DEG selection. Log-fold-change columns use the corresponding log2 threshold.

parameters.name: Minimum DEG Genes
parameters.description: Desired minimum selected-gene count per comparison and direction before a warning is reported.

parameters.name: Minimum Significant Comparisons
parameters.description: Number of distinct comparisons in which a pathway must meet export criteria.

parameters.name: Write Shared Bubble Plots
parameters.description: Write standardized OMIX combined and collection-specific pathway bubble plots plus a manifest.

parameters.name: Top Pathways per Plot
parameters.description: Top significant pathways selected independently for each plot scope. Enter 0 to include all eligible pathways.

parameters.name: Bubble Plot Significance Statistic
parameters.description: Use adjusted p-value/FDR (padj) or nominal p-value (pval) for shared-plot selection and significance shapes.

parameters.name: Collection Color Scale
parameters.description: Use independent score ranges for collection-specific plots or one shared range across collections.

parameters.name: Use Built-in Gene Universe
parameters.description: Use the L2P built-in universe instead of all genes detected in the DEG table.

parameters.name: Minimum Pathway Hits
parameters.description: Pathways must have more than this many selected-gene hits to meet export criteria.

parameters.name: Pathway Size Limit
parameters.description: Remove pathways whose tested size is not below this limit.

parameters.name: Pathway Significance Threshold
parameters.description: Nominal p-value or FDR threshold used to retain exported pathways.

parameters.name: Use FDR for Export Significance
parameters.description: Apply the pathway significance threshold to L2P FDR instead of nominal p-value.

parameters.name: Custom Pathway Name Column
parameters.description: Pathway-name column in a tabular custom pathway database.

parameters.name: Custom Pathway Gene Column
parameters.description: Gene-symbol column in a tabular custom pathway database.

parameters.name: Pathways to Remove
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated exact pathway names to remove from exported results and shared plots.
